def evaluate_1_divide_2(numerator, denominator):
    if denominator == 0:
        return "Cannot divide by zero"
    return numerator / denominator

numerator = 1
denominator = 2
result = evaluate_1_divide_2(numerator, denominator)
print(f"The result of 1 / {numerator} / {denominator} is {result}")
